name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  classical
  intro n hn
  cases n with
  | zero => contradiction
  | succ n =>
    clear hn
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      simp only [zero_add, ModuleCode]
      intro u hp
      simp only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (u := u),
        prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F)
          (P := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e),
        Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hp
      have hc := hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hp
      simp only [jointProximityNat₂, Fin.isValue] at hc
      have hu : u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) := by
        funext i
        match i with
        | 0 => rfl
        | 1 => rfl
      rw [hu.symm] at hc
      exact hc
    | succ k ih =>
      intro u hp
      let U₀ : WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (k + 1))) ι :=
        (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := k + 1) u).1
      let U₁ : WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (k + 1))) ι :=
        (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := k + 1) u).2
      have heq (r : Fin (k + 1 + 1) → F) :
          multilinearCombine u r =
            multilinearCombine (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ (r (Fin.last (k + 1))))
              (fun i => r i.castSucc) := by
        rw [multilinearCombine_recursive_form]
        rfl
      simp only [heq] at hp
      rw [prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun
        (ϑ := k + 1) (F := F)
        (P := fun rl ri =>
          Δ₀(multilinearCombine (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ rl) ri, MC) ≤ e)] at hp
      have hR := prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε)
        (ϑ := k + 1) (u := u) (e := e) hp
      apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
      apply h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ (k + 1)) Nat.one_le_two_pow
        (u₀ := ⋈|U₀) (u₁ := ⋈|U₁)
      apply lt_of_lt_of_le hR
      apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hr
      exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor (MC := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε)
        (ih := ih) (u := u) ⟨r, hr⟩

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  simp only
  intro y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) coeffs
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    have h := iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)
    simp only [Subtype.eq_iff] at h
    rw [h.symm]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1
      (by omega) (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  have hd : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    have h₀ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have h₁ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    dsimp only at h₀ h₁
    dsimp only [x₀, x₁, fiberMap]
    rw [h₁, h₀]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add,
      Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_basis, add_zero,
      normalizedWᵢ_eval_βᵢ_eq_1, add_sub_cancel_right]
  have hs := evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs
  have he (k : Fin 2) : P.eval (fiberMap k).val =
      P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [P, hs, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, hq,
      Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, P₀, P₁]
  change P.eval x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
    P.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) = _
  rw [he 0, he 1]
  calc
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal := by
      rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hd]
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [P₀, P₁, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
        Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
        Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  have hi : i.val < r := by omega
  have his : i.val + steps < r := by omega
  have he₁ : ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val := by omega
  have he₂ : ℓ - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ - i.val := by omega
  let a : Fin (ℓ + 1) := ⟨i, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩
  let b : Fin (ℓ + 1) := ⟨i.val + steps, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h_i_add_steps⟩
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) a
  let d := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f
  haveI : Nonempty C := ⟨⟨0, C.zero_mem⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr
    (Set.univ_nonempty : (Set.univ : Set C).Nonempty) :
      ((fun g : C => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ).Nonempty)
  have hmin : d = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard := hg.symm
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let Q := fun (y : sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i.val + steps, his⟩) =>
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps))).image
      (qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, hi⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) (y := y))
  have hsub : Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g.val x) ⊆ Y.toFinset.biUnion Q := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
    let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
    apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨y, Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨x, rfl, hx'⟩
    · apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      refine ⟨pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := a) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (x := x), Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps (x := x) (y := y)).mp rfl
  have hdist : hammingDist f g ≤ d * 2 ^ steps := by
    rw [hmin]
    change (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g.val x)).card ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps
    calc
      _ ≤ (Y.toFinset.biUnion Q).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      _ ≤ Y.toFinset.card * 2 ^ steps := by
        apply Finset.card_biUnion_le_card_mul
        intro y hy
        exact (Finset.card_image_le).trans_eq (Finset.card_univ.trans (Fintype.card_fin _))
      _ = Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
        simp only [Set.toFinset_card]
        rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
        simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have hfw : 2 * d ≤ BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 b - 1 :=
    Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have hid : (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 b - 1) * 2 ^ steps =
      BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 a - 1 := by
    dsimp [BBF_CodeDistance, a, b]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add, he₁, he₂]
  have hnat : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 a := by
    have hle := (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hdist).trans
      (by simpa only [mul_assoc] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) hfw)
    rw [hid] at hle
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_pred (Nat.zero_lt_succ _) hle
  unfold hammingClose
  calc
    _ ≤ 2 * (hammingDist f g : ℕ∞) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_left'
      apply sInf_le
      exact ⟨g, g.property, le_rfl⟩
    _ < _ := by
      change ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) * (hammingDist f g : ℕ∞) < _
      rw [← ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_lt_coe]
      exact hnat

name: Combine.master_lemma
proof:
lemma master_lemma
  [Nonempty ι]
  {φ : ι ↪ F} {dstar m : ℕ}
  {fs : Fin m → ι → F} {degs : Fin m → ℕ} (hdegs : ∀ i, degs i ≤ dstar)
  {δ : ℝ≥0}
  (hδLt : δ < (min (1 - (ReedSolomon.sqrtRate dstar φ))
    (1 - (rate (code φ dstar)) - 1 / Fintype.card ι)))
  {S : Finset ι}
  (hS_card : (1 - δ) * (Fintype.card ι) ≤ S.card)
  {v : (i : Fin m) → Fin (block_size dstar degs i) → Polynomial F}
  (hv_deg : ∀ i j, (v i j).degree < dstar)
  (hv_eval : ∀ i j, ∀ x ∈ S, (v i j).eval (φ x) = (φ x) ^ j.val * (fs i x))
  (i : Fin m)
  (j : Fin (block_size dstar degs i)) :
  (v i j).degree < degs i + j := by
  have hlt : dstar < Fintype.card ι := by
    by_contra! hn
    have hh := (lt_min_iff.mp hδLt).2
    simp [ReedSolomon.rateOfLinearCode_eq_min_div, min_eq_right hn] at hh
  have hcard : dstar + 1 ≤ (Finset.image φ S).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ φ.injective]
    have h : ↑(rate (code φ dstar)) + 1 / ↑(Fintype.card ι) < 1 - δ :=
      glorious_lemma (by simpa using hδLt) (by simp only [rate]; rfl)
    rw [ReedSolomon.rateOfLinearCode_eq_min_div, min_eq_left hlt.le] at h
    exact_mod_cast (even_more_glorious_lemma (m := Fintype.card ι) (by simp) (by simpa using h)).le.trans hS_card
  rcases j with ⟨j, hj⟩
  simp only [block_size] at hj
  generalize he : dstar - degs i - j = k
  revert j
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro j hj he
    have h : degs i + j = dstar := by have := hdegs i; omega
    change (v i ⟨j, hj⟩).degree < ((degs i + j : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ)
    rw [h]
    exact hv_deg i ⟨j, hj⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    intro j hj he
    have hj1 : j + 1 < dstar - degs i + 1 := by omega
    specialize ih (j + 1) hj1 (by omega)
    have hp : v i ⟨j, hj⟩ * Polynomial.X = v i ⟨j + 1, hj1⟩ := by
      apply Polynomial.eq_of_eval_eq_degree (n := dstar + 1)
      · rw [Polynomial.degree_mul, Polynomial.degree_X, WithBot.coe_add, WithBot.coe_one]
        exact (WithBot.add_lt_add_iff_right (by simp : (1 : WithBot ℕ) ≠ ⊥)).2 (hv_deg i ⟨j, hj⟩)
      · exact lt_trans (hv_deg _ _) (WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self dstar))
      · exact hcard
      · intro y hy
        obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
        simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hv_eval _ _ x hx, pow_succ]
        ring
    rw [←hp] at ih
    simp only [Polynomial.degree_mul, Polynomial.degree_X, WithBot.coe_add, WithBot.coe_one, ←add_assoc] at ih
    exact (WithBot.add_lt_add_iff_right (by simp)).mp ih

name: JohnsonBound.johnson_bound_alphabet_free
proof:
theorem johnson_bound_alphabet_free [Field F]
    {B : Finset (Fin n → F)} {v : Fin n → F} {e : ℕ} (hB : 1 < B.card) :
    let d := sInf { d | ∃ u ∈ B, ∃ v ∈ B, u ≠ v ∧ hammingDist u v = d }
    let q : ℚ := card F
    let _frac := q / (q - 1)
    e ≤ n - ((n * (n - d)) : ℝ).sqrt →
    (B ∩ ({ x | Δ₀(x, v) ≤ e } : Finset _)).card ≤ q * d * n := by
  intro d q frac h
  let B' := B ∩ ({ x | Δ₀(x, v) ≤ e } : Finset _)
  have q_not_small : q ≥ (2 : ℚ) := by
    change (2 : ℚ) ≤ (card F : ℚ)
    exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt (show 1 < card F from by
      simpa [Fintype.one_lt_card_iff] using (⟨(0 : F), (1 : F), by simp⟩ : ∃ a b : F, a ≠ b))
  have hd_mem : d ∈ { k | ∃ u ∈ B, ∃ w ∈ B, u ≠ w ∧ hammingDist u w = k } :=
    Nat.sInf_mem (by
      obtain ⟨u, hu, w, hw, huw⟩ := one_lt_card.mp hB
      exact ⟨hammingDist u w, u, hu, w, hw, huw, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨u, hu, w, hw, huw, hd⟩ := hd_mem
  have d_not_small : 1 ≤ d := hd ▸ Nat.succ_le_of_lt (hammingDist_pos.mpr huw)
  have d_le_n : d ≤ n := by
    rw [← hd]
    simpa using hammingDist_le_card_fintype (x := u) (y := w)
  have n_not_small : n ≥ 1 := le_trans d_not_small d_le_n
  by_cases h_size : B'.card < 2
  · exact le_trans (show (B'.card : ℚ) ≤ 1 from by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_lt_succ h_size)
      (le_trans (by norm_num : (1 : ℚ) ≤ 2)
        (by simpa [mul_assoc] using johnson_qdn_ge_two q_not_small d_not_small n_not_small))
  · have hd_le_dB' : (d : ℚ) ≤ JohnsonBound.d B' := by
      let S' : Set ℕ := { d | ∃ u ∈ B', ∃ v ∈ B', u ≠ v ∧ hammingDist u v = d }
      have hS'nonempty : S'.Nonempty := by
        obtain ⟨u, hu, w, hw, huw⟩ := one_lt_card.mp (show 1 < B'.card by omega)
        exact ⟨hammingDist u w, u, hu, w, hw, huw, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨u, hu, w, hw, huw, hd⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hS'nonempty
      calc (d : ℚ)
          ≤ ↑(sInf S') := by
            exact_mod_cast (Nat.sInf_le
              ⟨u, (mem_inter.mp hu).1, w, (mem_inter.mp hw).1, huw, hd⟩ : d ≤ sInf S')
        _ ≤ JohnsonBound.d B' := by exact_mod_cast min_dist_le_d (B := B') (by omega)
    have hn_pos_nat : 0 < n := Nat.succ_le_iff.1 n_not_small
    have hn_pos : (0 : ℚ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn_pos_nat
    have hq1_pos : (0 : ℚ) < q - 1 := by linarith only [q_not_small]
    have hq_pos : (0 : ℚ) < q := by linarith only [q_not_small]
    by_cases h_d_close_n : q / (q - 1) * (d / n) > 1
    · have hden_lb : (1 : ℚ) / (n * (q - 1)) ≤ JohnsonDenominator B' v :=
        le_trans (johnson_gap_frac_d_gt_one (B := B')
          (q_not_small := q_not_small) (n_not_small := n_not_small)
          (h_d_close_n := h_d_close_n) (hd_le_dB := hd_le_dB')) (by
          simpa only [JohnsonDenominator, mul_div_assoc] using
            johnson_den_ge_frac_d (B := B') (v := v))
      have h_strong : JohnsonConditionStrong B' v :=
        johnson_condition_strong_iff_johnson_denom_pos.2
          (lt_of_lt_of_le (one_div_pos.mpr (mul_pos hn_pos hq1_pos)) hden_lb)
      have hnum_nonneg : (0 : ℚ) ≤ frac * JohnsonBound.d B' / n :=
        div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hq_pos.le hq1_pos.le)
          (le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le d) hd_le_dB')) hn_pos.le
      refine le_trans (johnson_bound h_strong) ?_
      calc (frac * JohnsonBound.d B' / n) / JohnsonDenominator B' v
          ≤ (frac * JohnsonBound.d B' / n) / (1 / (n * (q - 1))) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnum_nonneg
              (one_div_pos.mpr (mul_pos hn_pos hq1_pos)) hden_lb
        _ = q * JohnsonBound.d B' := by
            dsimp only [frac]
            generalize JohnsonBound.d B' = D
            field_simp [hn_pos.ne', hq1_pos.ne']
            <;> ring
        _ ≤ q * d * n := by
            have hd_le_n := johnson_d_le_n (B := B') (le_of_not_gt h_size)
            have hd_ge1 : (1 : ℚ) ≤ (d : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast d_not_small
            calc q * JohnsonBound.d B' ≤ q * n := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd_le_n hq_pos.le
                 _ ≤ q * d * n := by
                   simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                     (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd_ge1 hq_pos.le) hn_pos.le
    · have hn_nonneg : (0 : ℚ) ≤ n := hn_pos.le
      have hfrac_pos : (0 : ℚ) < frac := div_pos hq_pos hq1_pos
      have hfrac_gt1 : (1 : ℚ) < frac :=
        (one_lt_div hq1_pos).2 (sub_lt_self q zero_lt_one)
      have hn2_pos : (0 : ℚ) < (n : ℚ) ^ 2 := pow_pos hn_pos _
      have h_div'_real := JohnsonBound.johnson_hyp_implies_div_ineq hn_pos_nat d_le_n h
      have h_div'_q : (1 - (d / n : ℚ)) ≤ (1 - (e / n : ℚ)) ^ 2 := by
        have hc : ((1 - (d / n : ℚ)) : ℝ) ≤ ((1 - (e / n : ℚ)) ^ 2 : ℝ) := by
          simpa using h_div'_real
        exact_mod_cast hc
      have h_johnson_strong : JohnsonConditionStrong B' v := by
        have h_muln : (e : ℚ) / n ≤ 1 - ((1 - (d : ℚ) / n) : ℝ).sqrt := by
          have he_le : (e : ℝ) ≤ n := by
            linarith only [h, sqrt_nonneg ((n : ℝ) * (n - d))]
          have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn_pos_nat
          have he_div : (e : ℝ) / n ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hnR).2 he_le
          have hroot : √(1 - (d : ℝ) / n) ≤ 1 - (e : ℝ) / n :=
            sqrt_le_iff.mpr ⟨sub_nonneg.mpr he_div, h_div'_real⟩
          push_cast
          linarith only [hroot]
        have h_J_bound : 1 - ((1 - (d : ℚ) / n) : ℝ).sqrt ≤ J q (d / n) := by
          simpa using sqrt_le_J (by linarith only [q_not_small] : q > 1)
            (div_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast Nat.cast_nonneg d) hn_nonneg)
            ((div_le_one hn_pos).2 (by exact_mod_cast d_le_n))
            (le_of_not_gt h_d_close_n)
        exact johnson_condition_weak_implies_strong
          (lt_of_le_of_ne (le_trans h_muln h_J_bound) (johnson_e_div_ne_J hn_pos_nat
            (Nat.succ_le_iff.1 d_not_small) (by linarith only [q_not_small]) h_muln h_J_bound
            (le_of_not_gt h_d_close_n)))
          (show 1 < B'.card by omega) (by exact_mod_cast (show (2 : ℚ) ≤ (card F : ℚ) from q_not_small))
      refine le_trans (johnson_bound h_johnson_strong) ?_
      set D0 : ℚ := d / n
      set E0 : ℚ := e / n
      set Den : ℚ := D0 - 2 * E0 + frac * E0 ^ 2
      have quad_nonneg : (0 : ℚ) ≤ D0 - 2 * E0 + E0 ^ 2 := by nlinarith only [h_div'_q]
      have frac_sub_one_eq : frac - 1 = (1 : ℚ) / (q - 1) := by
        dsimp only [frac]; field_simp; ring
      have one_div_q_le : (1 : ℚ) / q ≤ frac - 1 := by
        rw [frac_sub_one_eq]
        exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hq1_pos (by linarith only : q - 1 ≤ q)
      have denom_expansion : JohnsonDenominator B' v =
          frac * (JohnsonBound.d B' / n - 2 * JohnsonBound.e B' v / n +
          frac * (JohnsonBound.e B' v / n) ^ 2) := by
        change (1 - frac * JohnsonBound.e B' v / n) ^ 2 -
          (1 - frac * JohnsonBound.d B' / n) = _
        ring
      have e_ineq : JohnsonBound.e B' v ≤ e := by
        simpa [B'] using JohnsonBound.e_ball_le_radius (B := B) (v := v) (r := (e : ℚ))
          (by simpa [B'] using show 0 < B'.card by omega)
      have hden1_pos : (0 : ℚ) <
          JohnsonBound.d B' / n - 2 * JohnsonBound.e B' v / n +
          frac * (JohnsonBound.e B' v / n) ^ 2 := by
        have hdenJ := johnson_condition_strong_iff_johnson_denom_pos.1 h_johnson_strong
        rw [denom_expansion] at hdenJ
        exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hfrac_pos).1 hdenJ
      have worst_case_bound :=
        johnson_worst_case_bound hn_pos (Nat.succ_le_iff.1 d_not_small) d_le_n h
          (le_of_not_gt h_d_close_n) hfrac_gt1 e_ineq hd_le_dB' quad_nonneg hden1_pos
      have hden_lb : (1 : ℚ) / (q * (n : ℚ) ^ 2) ≤ Den := by
        by_cases he0 : e = 0
        · subst he0; simpa [D0, E0, Den] using
            johnson_den_lb_e_zero hn_pos_nat (by linarith only [q_not_small]) (by exact_mod_cast d_not_small)
        · exact johnson_den_lb_e_pos hn_pos he0 one_div_q_le
            (sub_pos.mpr hfrac_gt1) quad_nonneg
      rw [denom_expansion, mul_div_assoc, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hfrac_pos.ne']
      refine le_trans worst_case_bound ?_
      suffices (d / n) / Den ≤ q * d * n by
        simpa only [Den, D0, E0, mul_div_assoc] using this
      calc (d / n) / Den
          ≤ (d / n) / ((1 : ℚ) / (q * (n : ℚ) ^ 2)) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left
              (div_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le d) hn_nonneg)
              (one_div_pos.mpr (mul_pos hq_pos hn2_pos)) hden_lb
        _ = q * d * n := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hq_pos, ne_of_gt hn_pos]

name: ProximityToRS.dir_close_of_many_close_pts
proof:
lemma dir_close_of_many_close_pts
    {deg : ℕ}
    {α : ι ↪ F} {e : ℕ} {u v : ι → F}
    (he : (e : ℚ≥0) < ‖(RScodeSet α deg)‖₀ / 3)
    (h_many : numberOfClosePts u v deg α e > ‖(RScodeSet α deg)‖₀) :
    Δ₀(v, ReedSolomon.code α deg) ≤ e := by
  classical
  let CRS := ReedSolomon.code α deg
  let C : Set (ι → F) := CRS
  have h3e : 3 * e < ‖C‖₀ := by
    have h : (3 : ℚ≥0) * e < (‖C‖₀ : ℚ≥0) := by
      simpa [mul_comm] using
        (lt_div_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ≥0) < 3)).mp he
    exact_mod_cast h
  let P : F → Prop := fun r ↦ Δ₀(u + r • v, C) ≤ e
  let RS := {r : F // P r}
  have hcount : numberOfClosePts u v deg α e ≤ Fintype.card RS := by
    let f : RS → closePtsOnAffineLine (F := F) (u := u) (v := v)
        (deg := deg) (α := α) (e := e) := fun r ↦
      ⟨u + r.1 • v, (Affine.mem_affineLineAtOrigin_iff (F := F)
        (origin := u) (direction := v) _).2 ⟨r.1, rfl⟩, r.2⟩
    have hf : Function.Surjective f := by
      intro x
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (Affine.mem_affineLineAtOrigin_iff (F := F)
        (origin := u) (direction := v) x.1).1 x.2.1
      refine ⟨⟨r, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · simpa [P, hr] using x.2.2
      · apply Subtype.ext
        exact hr.symm
    exact Fintype.card_le_of_surjective f hf
  have hn : ‖C‖₀ < Fintype.card RS := lt_of_lt_of_le h_many hcount
  have hn1 : 1 < (Finset.univ : Finset RS).card := by
    simp only [Finset.card_univ]
    omega
  obtain ⟨r0, -, r1, -, hr01⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp hn1
  have hclose (r : RS) : ∃ c ∈ C, Δ₀(u + r.1 • v, c) ≤ e :=
    (Code.closeToCode_iff_closeToCodeword_of_minDist
      (u := u + r.1 • v) (C := C) (e := e)).1 r.2
  choose c hc hd using hclose
  have herr (r : RS) : ∃ E : Finset ι, E.card ≤ e ∧
      ∀ j, j ∉ E → (u + r.1 • v) j = c r j :=
    (Code.closeToWord_iff_exists_possibleDisagreeCols
      (u := u + r.1 • v) (v := c r) (e := e)).1 (hd r)
  choose E hE hA using herr
  have diff (r s : RS) (j : ι) (hr : j ∉ E r) (hs : j ∉ E s) :
      (s.1 - r.1) * v j = c s j - c r j := by
    simpa [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, sub_mul] using
      congrArg₂ (fun a b : F ↦ a - b) (hA s j hs) (hA r j hr)
  have slope (r s : RS) (hne : s.1 - r.1 ≠ 0) (j : ι)
      (hr : j ∉ E r) (hs : j ∉ E s) :
      v j = ((s.1 - r.1)⁻¹ • (c s - c r)) j := by
    simp [Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, ← diff r s j hr hs, hne]
  have h10 : r1.1 - r0.1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (by
    intro h
    exact hr01 (Subtype.ext h.symm))
  let w := (r1.1 - r0.1)⁻¹ • (c r1 - c r0)
  have hw : w ∈ CRS := CRS.smul_mem _ (CRS.sub_mem (hc r1) (hc r0))
  have hcode (r : RS) : c r - c r0 = (r.1 - r0.1) • w := by
    apply Code.eq_of_lt_dist (C := C)
    · exact CRS.sub_mem (hc r) (hc r0)
    · exact CRS.smul_mem _ hw
    · have hdist : Δ₀(c r - c r0, (r.1 - r0.1) • w) ≤
          (E r0 ∪ E r1 ∪ E r).card := by
        apply hamming_dist_le_of_subset_disagree
        intro j hj
        by_contra hnot
        have hnot' : j ∉ E r0 ∧ j ∉ E r1 ∧ j ∉ E r := by
          simpa only [Finset.mem_union, not_or, and_assoc] using hnot
        have hv : v j = w j := slope r0 r1 h10 j hnot'.1 hnot'.2.1
        apply hj
        simpa only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← hv] using
          (diff r0 r j hnot'.1 hnot'.2.2).symm
      have hu := Finset.card_union_le (E r0) (E r1)
      have hu' := Finset.card_union_le (E r0 ∪ E r1) (E r)
      have h0 := hE r0
      have h1 := hE r1
      have hr := hE r
      omega
  let D := Finset.univ.filter (fun j ↦ v j ≠ w j)
  have hlow (j : ι) (hj : j ∈ D) :
      Fintype.card RS - 1 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun r : RS ↦ j ∈ E r)).card := by
    have hclean : (Finset.univ.filter (fun r : RS ↦ j ∉ E r)).card ≤ 1 := by
      by_contra h
      obtain ⟨r, hr, s, hs, hrs⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp (lt_of_not_ge h)
      have hne : s.1 - r.1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr
        (fun h ↦ hrs (Subtype.ext h.symm))
      have hd : c s - c r = (s.1 - r.1) • w := by
        calc
          _ = (c s - c r0) - (c r - c r0) := (sub_sub_sub_cancel_right _ _ _).symm
          _ = _ := by rw [hcode s, hcode r, ← sub_smul, sub_sub_sub_cancel_right]
      have hv := slope r s hne j (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).2
      rw [hd, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, one_smul] at hv
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2 hv
    have hsum := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
      (s := (Finset.univ : Finset RS)) (p := fun r ↦ j ∈ E r)
    simp only [Finset.card_univ] at hsum
    omega
  have hupper : (∑ j ∈ D, (Finset.univ.filter (fun r : RS ↦ j ∈ E r)).card)
      ≤ Fintype.card RS * e := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ j : ι, (Finset.univ.filter (fun r : RS ↦ j ∈ E r)).card := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ D)
        intro j _ _
        exact Nat.zero_le _
      _ = ∑ r : RS, (E r).card := by
        simp only [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Finset.sum_filter]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        simp [← Finset.sum_filter]
      _ ≤ ∑ r : RS, e := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun r _ ↦ hE r)
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hlower : D.card * (Fintype.card RS - 1) ≤
      ∑ j ∈ D, (Finset.univ.filter (fun r : RS ↦ j ∈ E r)).card := by
    simpa using Finset.sum_le_sum hlow
  have hD : D.card ≤ e := by
    have hbound := le_trans hlower hupper
    have hnsub : Fintype.card RS = (Fintype.card RS - 1) + 1 := by omega
    have he' : e < Fintype.card RS - 1 := by omega
    by_contra h
    have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (Fintype.card RS - 1) (show e + 1 ≤ D.card by omega)
    have hh := le_trans hm hbound
    rw [hnsub] at hh
    simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] at hh
    rw [Nat.mul_comm e] at hh
    exact (not_le_of_gt he') (Nat.le_of_add_le_add_left hh)
  have hvw : Δ₀(v, w) ≤ D.card := by
    apply hamming_dist_le_of_subset_disagree
    intro j hj
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hj⟩
  exact le_trans (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem (C := C) (u := v) (v := w) hw)
    (by exact_mod_cast le_trans hvw hD)

name: ProximityGap.RS_exists_nonzero_kernelVec_of_det_eq_zero_natDegree_le_one
proof:
theorem RS_exists_nonzero_kernelVec_of_det_eq_zero_natDegree_le_one (e : ℕ)
    (K : Matrix (Fin (e + 1)) (Fin (e + 1)) F[X])
    (hdeg : ∀ i j, (K i j).natDegree ≤ 1)
    (hdet : Matrix.det K = 0) :
    ∃ a : Fin (e + 1) → F[X],
      a ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ t, (a t).natDegree ≤ e) ∧ Matrix.mulVec K a = 0 := by
  classical
  let n : ℕ := e + 1
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun r =>
    ∃ (I J : Fin r ↪ Fin n), Matrix.det (K.submatrix I J) ≠ 0
  have hP0 : P 0 := by
    refine ⟨Function.Embedding.ofIsEmpty, Function.Embedding.ofIsEmpty, ?_⟩
    simp
  let r : ℕ := Nat.findGreatest P n
  have hPr : P r := by
    have h :=
      Nat.findGreatest_spec (P := P) (m := 0) (n := n) (Nat.zero_le n) hP0
    simpa [r] using h
  rcases hPr with ⟨I, J, hIJ⟩
  have hPn : ¬ P n := by
    intro h
    rcases h with ⟨I0, J0, hdet0⟩
    have hzero := RS_det_submatrix_eq_zero_of_det_eq_zero n K hdet I0 J0
    exact hdet0 hzero
  have hr_le : r ≤ n := by
    simpa [r] using (Nat.findGreatest_le (P := P) n)
  have hr_lt : r < n := by
    have hr_ne : r ≠ n := by
      intro hEq
      have : P n := by
        simpa [hEq] using (show P r from ⟨I, J, hIJ⟩)
      exact hPn this
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hr_le hr_ne
  have hr_le_e : r ≤ e := by
    have : r < e + 1 := by
      simpa [n] using hr_lt
    exact (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp this)
  have hnotP_succ : ¬ P (r + 1) := by
    have hr1_le : r + 1 ≤ n := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hr_lt
    have hk : Nat.findGreatest P n < r + 1 := by
      simp [r]
    exact Nat.findGreatest_is_greatest (P := P) (n := n) (k := r + 1) hk hr1_le
  have hcard_lt_I : (Finset.univ.map I).card < (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).card := by
    simpa [Finset.card_map, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using hr_lt
  obtain ⟨i0, -, hi0_not_mem⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_notMem_of_card_lt_card hcard_lt_I
  have hi0 : i0 ∉ Set.range I := by
    intro hi
    rcases hi with ⟨t, rfl⟩
    have : (I t) ∈ (Finset.univ.map I) := by
      simp
    exact hi0_not_mem this
  have hcard_lt_J : (Finset.univ.map J).card < (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).card := by
    simpa [Finset.card_map, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using hr_lt
  obtain ⟨j0, -, hj0_not_mem⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_notMem_of_card_lt_card hcard_lt_J
  have hj0 : j0 ∉ Set.range J := by
    intro hj
    rcases hj with ⟨t, rfl⟩
    have : (J t) ∈ (Finset.univ.map J) := by
      simp
    exact hj0_not_mem this
  let I' : Fin (r + 1) ↪ Fin n := Fin.Embedding.snoc I hi0
  let J' : Fin (r + 1) ↪ Fin n := Fin.Embedding.snoc J hj0
  let B : Matrix (Fin (r + 1)) (Fin (r + 1)) F[X] := K.submatrix I' J'
  have hdetB : Matrix.det B = 0 := by
    by_contra h
    exact hnotP_succ ⟨I', J', h⟩
  let u : Fin (r + 1) → F[X] := fun t => B.adjugate t (Fin.last r)
  have hBu : Matrix.mulVec B u = 0 := by
    simpa [u] using
      (RS_mulVec_adjugate_col_eq_zero_of_det_eq_zero (n := r + 1) (A := B) (j := Fin.last r) hdetB)
  have hu_last : u (Fin.last r) ≠ 0 := by
    have hAdj := RS_adjugate_last_last_eq_det_submatrix_castSucc_castSucc (n := r) (B := B)
    have hBsub : B.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc = K.submatrix I J := by
      ext i j
      simp [B, I', J']
    have hUL :
        u (Fin.last r) =
          (-1 : F[X]) ^ ((Fin.last r : ℕ) + (Fin.last r : ℕ)) * Matrix.det (K.submatrix I J) := by
      dsimp [u]
      rw [hAdj]
      simp [hBsub]
    have hsign :
        ((-1 : F[X]) ^ ((Fin.last r : ℕ) + (Fin.last r : ℕ))) ≠ 0 := by
      have hbase : (-1 : F[X]) ≠ 0 := by
        simp
      exact pow_ne_zero _ hbase
    rw [hUL]
    exact mul_ne_zero hsign hIJ
  have hu_ne : u ≠ 0 := by
    intro hu0
    have h := congrArg (fun f => f (Fin.last r)) hu0
    have : u (Fin.last r) = 0 := by
      simpa using h
    exact hu_last this
  have hu_deg : ∀ t, (u t).natDegree ≤ e := by
    intro t
    have hAdj :
        u t =
          (-1 : F[X]) ^ ((Fin.last r : ℕ) + (t : ℕ)) *
            Matrix.det (B.submatrix Fin.castSucc t.succAbove) := by
      dsimp [u]
      exact RS_adjugate_fin_succ_eq_det_submatrix_last_castSucc (n := r) (B := B) (t := t)
    let M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) F[X] := B.submatrix Fin.castSucc t.succAbove
    have hdegM : ∀ i j, (M i j).natDegree ≤ 1 := by
      intro i j
      dsimp [M, B]
      exact hdeg (I' (Fin.castSucc i)) (J' (t.succAbove j))
    have hdetMdeg : (Matrix.det M).natDegree ≤ r :=
      RS_natDegree_det_le_of_entry_natDegree_le_one r M hdegM
    have hmuldeg : (u t).natDegree ≤ (Matrix.det M).natDegree := by
      rw [hAdj]
      dsimp [M]
      have hconst :
          (-1 : F[X]) ^ (r + (t : ℕ)) = Polynomial.C ((-1 : F) ^ (r + (t : ℕ))) := by
        simp
      rw [hconst]
      exact Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_le _ _
    have : (u t).natDegree ≤ r := le_trans hmuldeg hdetMdeg
    exact le_trans this hr_le_e
  let a : Fin n → F[X] := Function.extend (J' : Fin (r + 1) → Fin n) u (fun _ => 0)
  have ha_on : ∀ t : Fin (r + 1), a (J' t) = u t := by
    intro t
    simpa [a] using (J'.injective.extend_apply u (fun _ => 0) t)
  have ha_ne : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro ha0
    have h := congrArg (fun f => f (J' (Fin.last r))) ha0
    have ha_last : a (J' (Fin.last r)) = 0 := by
      simpa using h
    have : u (Fin.last r) = 0 := by
      calc
        u (Fin.last r) = a (J' (Fin.last r)) := by
          symm
          exact ha_on (Fin.last r)
        _ = 0 := ha_last
    exact hu_last this
  have ha_deg : ∀ t, (a t).natDegree ≤ e := by
    intro t
    by_cases ht : ∃ s : Fin (r + 1), (J' s : Fin n) = t
    · rcases ht with ⟨s, rfl⟩
      simpa [ha_on s] using hu_deg s
    · have : a t = 0 := by
        simpa [a] using
          (Function.extend_apply' (f := (J' : Fin (r + 1) → Fin n)) (g := u) (e' := fun _ => 0)
            (b := t) ht)
      simp [this]
  have hmulVec_eq (i : Fin n) :
      (Matrix.mulVec K a) i = ∑ j : Fin (r + 1), K i (J' j) * u j := by
    classical
    have houtside :
        ∀ j : Fin n,
          j ∉ Set.range (J' : Fin (r + 1) → Fin n) → K i j * a j = 0 := by
      intro j hj
      have hj' : ¬ ∃ t : Fin (r + 1), (J' t : Fin n) = j := hj
      have ha0 : a j = 0 := by
        simpa [a] using
          (Function.extend_apply' (f := (J' : Fin (r + 1) → Fin n)) (g := u) (e' := fun _ => 0)
            (b := j) hj')
      simp [ha0]
    have hsum :
        (∑ j : Fin n, K i j * a j) = ∑ t : Fin (r + 1), K i (J' t) * a (J' t) := by
      have h :=
        (Fintype.sum_of_injective (e := (J' : Fin (r + 1) → Fin n)) (he := J'.injective)
          (f := fun t : Fin (r + 1) => K i (J' t) * a (J' t))
          (g := fun j : Fin n => K i j * a j) (h' := houtside) (h := fun t => rfl))
      exact h.symm
    calc
      (Matrix.mulVec K a) i = ∑ j : Fin n, K i j * a j := by
        rfl
      _ = ∑ t : Fin (r + 1), K i (J' t) * a (J' t) := hsum
      _ = ∑ t : Fin (r + 1), K i (J' t) * u t := by
        refine Fintype.sum_congr _ _ ?_
        intro t
        rw [ha_on t]
  have hKa : Matrix.mulVec K a = 0 := by
    funext i
    have hrewrite := hmulVec_eq i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ Set.range I
    · rcases hi with ⟨t, rfl⟩
      have hBu_t : (Matrix.mulVec B u) (Fin.castSucc t) = 0 := by
        have := congrArg (fun f => f (Fin.castSucc t)) hBu
        simpa using this
      have hBsum :
          (Matrix.mulVec B u) (Fin.castSucc t) = ∑ j : Fin (r + 1), K (I t) (J' j) * u j := by
        simp [B, I', Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
      have hsum0 : (∑ j : Fin (r + 1), K (I t) (J' j) * u j) = 0 := by
        simpa [hBsum] using hBu_t
      exact hrewrite.trans hsum0
    · have hi' : i ∉ Set.range I := hi
      let Ii : Fin (r + 1) ↪ Fin n := Fin.Embedding.snoc I hi'
      let b : Fin (r + 1) → F[X] := fun j => K i (J' j)
      have hupdate : B.updateRow (Fin.last r) b = K.submatrix Ii J' := by
        ext irow jcol
        cases irow using Fin.lastCases with
        | last =>
            simp [B, I', Ii, b, Matrix.updateRow]
        | cast t =>
            simp [B, I', Ii, b, Matrix.updateRow]
      have hdetBi : Matrix.det (K.submatrix Ii J') = 0 := by
        by_contra h
        exact hnotP_succ ⟨Ii, J', h⟩
      have hdetUpdate : Matrix.det (B.updateRow (Fin.last r) b) = 0 := by
        simpa [hupdate] using hdetBi
      have hsum_eq_det :
          (∑ j : Fin (r + 1), K i (J' j) * u j) = Matrix.det (B.updateRow (Fin.last r) b) := by
        simpa [b, u] using
          (det_updateRow_eq_sum_mul_adjugate_col (A := B) (i := Fin.last r) (b := b)).symm
      have hsum0 : (∑ j : Fin (r + 1), K i (J' j) * u j) = 0 := by
        simpa [hsum_eq_det] using hdetUpdate
      exact hrewrite.trans hsum0
  refine ⟨a, ha_ne, ha_deg, ?_⟩
  simpa [a, n] using hKa

name: ProximityGap.RS_jointAgreement_of_goodCoeffs_card_gt
proof:
theorem RS_jointAgreement_of_goodCoeffs_card_gt {deg : ℕ} {domain : ι ↪ F} {δ : ℝ≥0}
    (hδ : δ ≤ relativeUniqueDecodingRadius (ι := ι) (F := F)
      (C := ReedSolomon.code domain deg))
    (u : WordStack F (Fin 2) ι)
    (hS : (RS_goodCoeffs (deg := deg) (domain := domain) u δ).card > Fintype.card ι) :
    jointAgreement (C := ReedSolomon.code domain deg) (δ := δ) (W := u) := by
  classical
  let n := Fintype.card ι
  let e := Nat.floor (δ * n)
  let good := RS_goodCoeffs (deg := deg) (domain := domain) u δ
  have hn : 0 < n := Fintype.card_pos
  have hg : n < good.card := hS
  by_cases hd : deg = 0
  · subst deg
    let bad := univ.image (fun i : ι => -(u 0 i) / u 1 i)
    have hb : bad.card ≤ n := card_image_le
    have hnot : ¬ good ⊆ bad := fun h => (not_le_of_gt hg) ((card_le_card h).trans hb)
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzb⟩ := Finset.not_subset.mp hnot
    have hr : δᵣ(u 0 + z • u 1, ReedSolomon.code domain 0) ≤ δ :=
      (mem_filter.mp hz).2
    rw [Code.relCloseToCode_iff_relCloseToCodeword_of_minDist] at hr
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hr⟩ := hr
    have hw0 : w = 0 := by simpa [ReedSolomon.code_zero] using hw
    rw [hw0] at hr
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hTa⟩ := (Code.relCloseToWord_iff_exists_agreementCols
      (u := u 0 + z • u 1) (v := (0 : ι → F)) (δ := δ)).1 hr
    refine ⟨T, (Code.relDist_floor_bound_iff_complement_bound n T.card δ).mp hT,
      (0 : Fin 2 → ι → F), ?_⟩
    intro k
    refine ⟨(ReedSolomon.code domain 0).zero_mem, ?_⟩
    intro i hi
    have he : u 0 i + z * u 1 i = 0 := by
      simpa [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using (hTa i).1 hi
    have h1 : u 1 i = 0 := by
      by_contra h1
      apply hzb
      have heq : z = -(u 0 i) / u 1 i := (eq_div_iff h1).mpr
        (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (by simpa only [add_comm] using he))
      exact mem_image.mpr ⟨i, mem_univ i, heq.symm⟩
    fin_cases k <;> simpa [h1, show u 0 i = 0 by simpa [h1] using he]
  · by_cases hdn : deg ≤ n
    · letI : NeZero deg := ⟨hd⟩
      have hBW : 2 * e < n - deg + 1 :=
        RS_BW_bound_of_le_relUDR (deg := deg) (domain := domain) hdn hδ
      have ⟨hed, hedeg, headd, hltdeg, hnat⟩ :
          (e + deg - 1) - e = deg - 1 ∧ e ≤ e + deg - 1 ∧
          (deg - 1) + e = e + deg - 1 ∧ e + deg - 1 < n - e ∧
          (e + deg - 1) + (e + 1) ≤ n := by omega
      have hgp : 0 < good.card := hn.trans hg
      have hfrac : (((e + deg - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / n + ((e + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / good.card) < 1 := by
        have hnq : (0 : ℚ) < n := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn
        have hng : (n : ℚ) < good.card := Nat.cast_lt.mpr hg
        have hsmall : ((e + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / good.card < ((e + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / n :=
          div_lt_div_of_pos_left (by positivity) hnq hng
        have hsum : ((e + deg - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) + ((e + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤ n := by
          exact_mod_cast hnat
        have hle : ((e + deg - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / n + ((e + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / n ≤ 1 := by
          rw [← add_div, div_le_iff₀ hnq]
          simpa using hsum
        exact (add_lt_add_right hsmall _).trans_le hle
      let Px := univ.map domain
      let Py := good
      haveI : Nonempty Px := by apply Finset.Nonempty.to_subtype; simp [Px]
      haveI : Nonempty Py := Finset.Nonempty.to_subtype (card_pos.mp hgp)
      have hEvalDeg (z : F) (f : F[X][Y]) :
          (evalY z f).natDegree ≤ degreeX f := by
        have he : evalY z f = ∑ j ∈ f.support, f.coeff j * (Polynomial.C z : F[X]) ^ j := by
          simp [evalY, eval_eq_sum, Polynomial.sum_def]
        rw [he]
        apply natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
        intro j hj
        exact (show (f.coeff j * (Polynomial.C z : F[X]) ^ j).natDegree ≤ (f.coeff j).natDegree by
          simpa [C_pow] using (natDegree_mul_C_le (f := f.coeff j) (a := z ^ j))).trans
            (coeff_natDegree_le_degreeX f j)
      have hcomm (x z : F) (f : F[X][Y]) :
          (evalX x f).eval z = (evalY z f).eval x := by
        rw [ps_eval_x_eq_map, eval_map]
        simpa [evalY] using (eval₂_at_apply (p := f) (f := evalRingHom x) (r := Polynomial.C z))
      obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hAx, hAy, hBx, hBy, hAB⟩ :=
        RS_exists_bivariate_AB_of_goodCoeffs_card_gt hdn hδ u hS
      let qx : F → F[X] := fun z => if hz : z ∈ good then
        Classical.choose (RS_exists_Pz_of_mem_goodCoeffs (deg := deg)
          (domain := domain) (δ := δ) u hz) else 0
      let qy : F → F[X] := fun x => Polynomial.C (u 0 (invFun domain x)) + Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (u 1 (invFun domain x))
      have hqx : ∀ z ∈ Py, (qx z).natDegree ≤ (e + deg - 1) - e ∧
          evalY z B = qx z * evalY z A := by
        intro z hz
        have hz' : z ∈ good := hz
        have hp : (qx z).natDegree < deg ∧ Δ₀(u 0 + z • u 1, (qx z).eval ∘ domain) ≤ e := by
          simpa only [qx, dif_pos hz'] using Classical.choose_spec
            (RS_exists_Pz_of_mem_goodCoeffs (deg := deg) (domain := domain) (δ := δ) u hz')
        refine ⟨by rw [hed]; exact Nat.le_pred_of_lt hp.1, ?_⟩
        let D := evalY z B - qx z * evalY z A
        obtain ⟨T, hT, hTa⟩ := (Code.closeToWord_iff_exists_agreementCols
          (u := u 0 + z • u 1) (v := (qx z).eval ∘ domain) (e := e)).1 hp.2
        have hroot : ∀ x ∈ T.image domain, D.eval x = 0 := by
          intro x hx
          obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
          have hi' : u 0 i + z * u 1 i = (qx z).eval (domain i) := by
            simpa [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using (hTa i).1 hi
          have hab := congrArg (fun p : F[X] => p.eval z) (hAB i)
          simp only [eval_mul, eval_add, eval_C, eval_X] at hab
          rw [hcomm, hcomm, hi'] at hab
          simpa [D, eval_sub, eval_mul, sub_eq_zero] using hab
        have hD : D.natDegree ≤ e + deg - 1 := by
          apply (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans
          apply max_le
          · exact (hEvalDeg z B).trans hBx
          · exact natDegree_mul_le.trans ((Nat.add_le_add (Nat.le_pred_of_lt hp.1)
              ((hEvalDeg z A).trans hAx)).trans_eq headd)
        have hlt : D.natDegree < (T.image domain).card := by
          rw [card_image_of_injective _ domain.injective]
          exact hD.trans_lt (hltdeg.trans_le hT)
        have hz0 := Polynomial.eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq_zero'
          (p := D) (s := T.image domain) hroot hlt
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz0
      have hqy : ∀ x ∈ Px, (qy x).natDegree ≤ (e + 1) - e ∧
          evalX x B = qy x * evalX x A := by
        intro x hx
        obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := mem_map.mp hx
        simp only [qy, leftInverse_invFun domain.injective i]
        refine ⟨?_, hAB i⟩
        have hlin : (Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (u 1 i) : F[X]).natDegree ≤ 1 := by
          simpa using (natDegree_mul_C_le (f := (Polynomial.X : F[X])) (a := u 1 i))
        simpa using (natDegree_add_le (Polynomial.C (u 0 i)) (Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (u 1 i))).trans (max_le (by simp) hlin)
      obtain ⟨P, hBA, hPx, hPy, ⟨Q, hQcard, hQsub, hQeval⟩, _⟩ :=
        polishchuk_spielman (a_x := e) (a_y := e) (b_x := e + deg - 1) (b_y := e + 1)
          (n_x := ⟨n, hn⟩) (n_y := ⟨good.card, hgp⟩)
          (h_bx_ge_ax := hedeg) (h_by_ge_ay := Nat.le_succ e)
          (A := A) (B := B) hA hAx hBx hAy hBy Px Py qx qy (by simp [Px, n]) (by simp [Py]) hqx hqy hfrac
      let S := Q.preimage domain domain.injective.injOn
      have himg : S.map domain = Q := by
        ext x
        constructor
        · intro hx
          obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := mem_map.mp hx
          exact mem_preimage.mp hi
        · intro hx
          obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := mem_map.mp (hQsub hx)
          exact mem_map.mpr ⟨i, mem_preimage.mpr hx, rfl⟩
      have hc : S.card = Q.card := by rw [← himg, card_map]
      refine ⟨S, (Code.relDist_floor_bound_iff_complement_bound n S.card δ).mp
        (by simpa [hc] using hQcard), ?_⟩
      have hm (j : ℕ) : (P.coeff j).eval ∘ domain ∈ ReedSolomon.code domain deg := by
        have hj := (coeff_natDegree_le_degreeX P j).trans hPx
        rw [hed] at hj
        have hlt : (P.coeff j).natDegree < deg := hj.trans_lt (Nat.pred_lt hd)
        refine ⟨P.coeff j, ?_, by ext i; rfl⟩
        simpa [mem_degreeLT] using (degree_le_natDegree (p := P.coeff j)).trans_lt
          (show ((P.coeff j).natDegree : WithBot ℕ) < deg by exact_mod_cast hlt)
      use fun k : Fin 2 => (P.coeff k.val).eval ∘ domain
      intro k
      refine ⟨hm k.val, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      have he := congrArg (fun p : F[X] => p.coeff k.val) (hQeval _ (mem_preimage.mp hi))
      fin_cases k <;> simpa [qy, ps_eval_x_eq_map, leftInverse_invFun domain.injective i] using he
    · have hmem (w : ι → F) : w ∈ ReedSolomon.code domain deg := by
        let p := Lagrange.interpolate univ domain w
        have hp : p.degree < (Fintype.card ι : WithBot ℕ) := by
          simpa [p] using (Lagrange.degree_interpolate_lt (s := univ) (v := domain) (r := w)
            (fun x _ y _ h => domain.injective h))
        refine ⟨p, ?_, ?_⟩
        · apply (mem_degreeLT).mpr
          exact hp.trans (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hdn))
        · ext i
          exact Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node (s := univ) (v := domain) (r := w)
            (fun x _ y _ h => domain.injective h) (mem_univ i)
      refine ⟨univ, by simp, u, ?_⟩
      intro k
      exact ⟨hmem (u k), fun i _ => by simp⟩

name: Sumcheck.Spec.SingleRound.Simple.reduction_perfectCompleteness
proof:
theorem reduction_perfectCompleteness :
    (reduction R deg D oSpec).perfectCompleteness init impl
      (inputRelation R deg D) (outputRelation R deg) := by

  intro ⟨target, oStmt⟩ () hValid
  simp only [inputRelation, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hValid
  simp only [reduction, Reduction.run, Prover.run, Verifier.run, prover, verifier,

    bind_pure_comp, Functor.map_map, Function.comp]
  split <;> rename_i hDir0
  · exact absurd hDir0 (by decide)
  try simp only [pure_bind, map_pure, Functor.map_map, Function.comp, bind_pure_comp]
  split <;> rename_i hDir1
  swap
  · exact absurd hDir1 (by decide)
  simp only [MonadLift.monadLift, liftM, monadLift, MonadLiftT.monadLift,
    OracleComp.liftComp_pure, pure_bind, map_pure, Functor.map_map, Function.comp,
    bind_pure_comp, Transcript.concat, Fin.snoc_last, Fin.snoc_castSucc,
    guard, if_pos hValid]
  rw [ge_iff_le, one_le_probEvent_iff, probEvent_eq_one_iff]
  constructor

    first
    | rw [OptionT.probFailure_eq, OptionT.run_mk]
      simp only [probFailure_eq_zero, zero_add]
      apply probOutput_eq_zero_of_not_mem_support
      simp only [support_bind, Set.mem_iUnion, not_exists]
      intro s _ hmem
      simp only [StateT.run'_eq, support_map, Set.mem_image] at hmem
      obtain ⟨⟨_, s'⟩, hmem, rfl⟩ := hmem
    | intro x hmem
      rw [OptionT.mem_support_iff] at hmem
      simp only [OptionT.run_mk, support_bind, Set.mem_iUnion] at hmem
      rcases hmem with ⟨s, _, hmem⟩
      simp only [StateT.run'_eq, support_map, Set.mem_image] at hmem
      rcases hmem with ⟨⟨_, s'⟩, hmem, rfl⟩
  all_goals
    erw [simulateQ_bind, StateT.run_bind, mem_support_bind_iff] at hmem
    rcases hmem with ⟨⟨x, s''⟩, hx, hs⟩
    erw [simulateQ_map, StateT.run_map] at hx

    rcases hx with ⟨⟨val, s₀⟩, hval, heq⟩
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj heq
    clear heq
    erw [simulateQ_bind, StateT.run_bind, mem_support_bind_iff] at hs
    rcases hs with ⟨⟨y, s'''⟩, hy, hs⟩
    erw [simulateQ_map, simulateQ_map, StateT.run_map] at hy
    simp only [support_map, Set.mem_image] at hy
    rcases hy with ⟨⟨val2, s₁⟩, hval2, heq2⟩
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj heq2
    clear heq2
    erw [simulateQ_bind, StateT.run_bind, mem_support_bind_iff] at hval
    rcases hval with ⟨⟨chal_res, s₂⟩, hchal, hval⟩
    erw [simulateQ_bind, simulateQ_map, simulateQ_pure] at hchal
    simp only [map_pure, pure_bind] at hchal
    erw [simulateQ_map, StateT.run_map] at hchal
    simp only [support_map, Set.mem_image] at hchal
    rcases hchal with ⟨⟨inner_val, s_inner⟩, hinner, heq_c⟩
    clear hinner
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj heq_c
    clear heq_c
    erw [simulateQ_pure] at hval
    simp only [StateT.run_pure, support_pure, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hval
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hval
    clear hval
    rw [Finset.sum_map] at hValid
    simp [QueryImpl.addLift_def, QueryImpl.liftTarget_apply,
      QueryImpl.add_apply_inl, QueryImpl.add_apply_inr,
      simulateQ_query, simulateQ_pure, simulateQ_bind, simulateQ_map,
      QueryImpl.simulateQ_add_liftComp_right, QueryImpl.simulateQ_add_liftComp_left,
      OracleComp.liftComp_map, OracleComp.liftComp_pure,
      Function.comp, OracleQuery.cont, OracleQuery.input_query,
      StateT.run_bind, StateT.run_map, StateT.run_pure,
      support_map, support_pure, Fin.snoc, hValid] at hval2
    rcases hval2 with ⟨_, ⟨_, rfl⟩, _, rfl⟩
    simp only [Option.getM, pure_bind] at hs
    erw [simulateQ_pure] at hs
    simp only [StateT.run_pure, support_pure, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hs
    first
    | exfalso; simpa using congr_arg Prod.fst hs
    | cases hs
      simp [outputRelation]

name: ps_coprime_case_constant
proof:
lemma ps_coprime_case_constant {F : Type} [Field F]
    (a_x a_y b_x b_y : ℕ) (n_x n_y : ℕ+)
    (h_bx_ge_ax : b_x ≥ a_x) (h_by_ge_ay : b_y ≥ a_y)
    (A B : F[X][Y]) (hA0 : A ≠ 0) (hB0 : B ≠ 0) (hrel : IsRelPrime A B)
    (h_f_degX : a_x ≥ degreeX A) (h_g_degX : b_x ≥ degreeX B)
    (h_f_degY : a_y ≥ natDegreeY A) (h_g_degY : b_y ≥ natDegreeY B)
    (P_x P_y : Finset F) [Nonempty P_x] [Nonempty P_y]
    (quot_x quot_y : F → F[X])
    (h_card_Px : n_x ≤ P_x.card) (h_card_Py : n_y ≤ P_y.card)
    (h_quot_x : ∀ y ∈ P_y, (quot_x y).natDegree ≤ (b_x - a_x) ∧
      evalY y B = (quot_x y) * (evalY y A))
    (h_quot_y : ∀ x ∈ P_x, (quot_y x).natDegree ≤ (b_y - a_y) ∧
      evalX x B = (quot_y x) * (evalX x A))
    (h_le_1 : 1 > (b_x : ℚ) / (n_x : ℚ) + (b_y : ℚ) / (n_y : ℚ)) :
    degreeX A = 0 ∧ natDegreeY A = 0 := by
  classical
  set mY := natDegreeY A
  set mX := degreeX A
  have bound (R : F[X]) (S : Finset F) (m n d : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ S.card)
      (hR : R ≠ 0) (hd : R.natDegree ≤ d)
      (hdiv : ∀ x ∈ S, (X - C x) ^ m ∣ R) : m * n ≤ d := by
    have hp := Finset.prod_dvd_of_coprime
      (fun _ _ _ _ hxy ↦ (pairwise_coprime_X_sub_C (fun _ _ h ↦ h) hxy).pow) hdiv
    have hdvd := natDegree_le_of_dvd hp hR
    rw [natDegree_prod _ _ (fun x _ ↦ pow_ne_zero _ (X_sub_C_ne_zero x))] at hdvd
    apply (Nat.mul_le_mul_left m hn).trans
    apply le_trans ?_ hd
    simpa only [natDegree_pow, natDegree_X_sub_C, Nat.mul_one, Finset.sum_const,
      smul_eq_mul, Nat.mul_comm] using hdvd
  have hmy_le_D : mY * (n_x : ℕ) ≤ mX * b_y + mY * b_x := by
    refine bound (resultant B A b_y mY) P_x mY n_x _ h_card_Px
      (ps_resultant_ne_zero_of_is_rel_prime _ _ b_y h_g_degY hA0 hrel) ?_ ?_
    · exact (ps_nat_degree_resultant_le A B mY b_y).trans
        (by simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using (Nat.add_le_add
          (Nat.mul_le_mul_left mY h_g_degX) (le_of_eq (Nat.mul_comm b_y (degreeX A)))))
    · intro x hx
      exact ps_resultant_dvd_pow_eval_x A B x (quot_y x) b_y
        (h_f_degY.trans h_by_ge_ay) h_g_degY
        ((h_quot_y x hx).1.trans (Nat.sub_le_sub_left h_f_degY b_y)) (h_quot_y x hx).2
  have hmx_le_D : mX * (n_y : ℕ) ≤ mX * b_y + mY * b_x := by
    refine bound (resultant (swap B) (swap A) b_x mX) P_y mX n_y _ h_card_Py ?_ ?_ ?_
    · dsimp [mX]
      rw [← ps_nat_degree_y_swap A]
      exact ps_resultant_ne_zero_of_is_rel_prime _ _ b_x
        (by rw [ps_nat_degree_y_swap]; exact h_g_degX)
        (fun h ↦ hA0 (swap.injective (by simpa using h))) (ps_is_rel_prime_swap hrel)
    · apply le_trans (ps_nat_degree_resultant_le (swap A) (swap B) mX b_x)
      apply Nat.add_le_add
      · rw [ps_degree_x_swap B]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h_g_degY
      · rw [ps_degree_x_swap A]; exact le_of_eq (Nat.mul_comm b_x (natDegreeY A))
    · intro y hy
      exact ps_resultant_dvd_pow_eval_y A B y (quot_x y) b_x
        (h_f_degX.trans h_bx_ge_ax) h_g_degX
        ((h_quot_x y hy).1.trans (Nat.sub_le_sub_left h_f_degX b_x)) (h_quot_x y hy).2
  suffices mX * b_y + mY * b_x = 0 by
    exact ⟨(mul_eq_zero.mp (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (hmx_le_D.trans_eq this))).resolve_right n_y.ne_zero,
      (mul_eq_zero.mp (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (hmy_le_D.trans_eq this))).resolve_right n_x.ne_zero⟩
  have hn_x0 : (0 : ℚ) < n_x := by exact_mod_cast n_x.pos
  have hn_y0 : (0 : ℚ) < n_y := by exact_mod_cast n_y.pos
  have hsmall : (b_x : ℚ) * n_y + (b_y : ℚ) * n_x < (n_x : ℚ) * n_y := by
    apply (div_lt_one (mul_pos hn_x0 hn_y0)).mp
    simpa only [div_add_div _ _ (ne_of_gt hn_x0) (ne_of_gt hn_y0), mul_comm] using h_le_1
  have hs : b_x * (n_y : ℕ) + b_y * (n_x : ℕ) < (n_x : ℕ) * n_y := by exact_mod_cast hsmall
  by_contra hD0
  have hp := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hs (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hD0)
  have hy := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (b_x * (n_y : ℕ)) hmy_le_D
  have hx := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (b_y * (n_x : ℕ)) hmx_le_D
  simp only [mul_add, add_mul, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] at hp hy hx
  clear * - hp hy hx
  omega
